messages.author: 5b55811f2e3aab0a
messages.subject: data frame error with advanced.procD.lm
parts:
Hi all,

This will just be a quick question. Not sure if this error I'm getting has been encountered before.

I mistakenly called the following

smelt.shp1<-advanced.procD.lm(shape ~(habitat/location)*sex, ~habitat/location, groups=~location, iter=999, data=gdf)

and got the following error.
Error in `[.data.frame`(m, xvars) : undefined columns selected

This suggests there are missing columns. But as you can see below, all the data are there, with the expected dimensions.
Interestingly, when I remove the 'groups= ~location", it runs the analysis and there is no error. Does that mean I have to specify the grouping factor differently?

Examples in Quickguide to geomorph and function help files suggest that I'm not doing anything wrong.

The data are contained in a gdf object:
gdf<-geomorph.data.frame(shape=smeltshp.gpa$coords, habitat=mydata$habitat, location=mydata$location, sex=mydata$sex)

> str(gdf)
List of 5
 $ shape  : num [1:16, 1:2, 1:669] -0.314 -0.189 0.132 0.197 0.35 ...
 $ Csize   : num [1:669] 0.0837 0.0787 0.0817 0.0824 0.0819 ...
 $ habitat : chr [1:669] "river" "river" "river" "river" ...
 $ location: chr [1:669] "bargo" "bargo" "bargo" "bargo" ...
 $ sex     : chr [1:669] "f" "f" "m" "m" ...
 - attr(*, "class")= chr "geomorph.data.frame"

Any thoughts on what's going on there? I've attached my data if anyone would like to try and reproduce the error.

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] data frame error with advanced.procD.lm
parts:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for the alert.  For reasons I cannot explain, a step in our code removed your habitat variable from the data frame (causing the undefined column).  I see no reason for it, but it happened.  I changed the code to do the same thing as before, but with a different function, and now it seems to work.  I pushed this change to our Stable version on Github.

Please verify if this fixed the problem (by downloading geomorph from github, and relaunching).

Cheers!
Mike

messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] data frame error with advanced.procD.lm
parts:
Hi Daniel,

No, it is not available on CRAN and will not be until we make the next large package update, which we can only do periodically.  You did not indicate the branch in your attempt, and the install_github function defaults to “Master”, which we do not have.  Instead do 

devtools::install_github("geomorphR/geomorph”, ref = “Stable)

Mike
